title: Practice 5: до-: as far as, reaching

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: В три часа ___ (донести / доносить — to carry, to bring, to deliver) черти.
exercises.why: **донесли** is the past tense (plural) of **донести** (to carry (to, as far as), to bring (to), to deliver; to report, to announce, to inform) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **доносить**. past: он донёс · она донесла́ · оно донесло́ · они донесли́. — Wiktionary, «донести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**до-** — Reaching a limit or destination Example: Пассажиры доехали до последней остановки и вышли из автобуса. — The passengers reached the last station and exited the bus. Prepositional phrases: до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «"Going verbs" with prefix "до-" indicate motion up to a certain point and may mean: a) going as far as …; b) reaching of a destination. Я доехал до угла и повернул направо. (went as far as…) У меня было мало бензина, но я всё-таки доехал до города. (reached the destination) These verbs are always followed by the preposition до + Gen.» — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Лев Толстой, «Война и мир».
